title: pagewire
description: Signal path, decoder, queue and delivery metrics of pagewire (pagewire_*).

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Prometheus data source. Hidden from the filter bar; change it under Dashboard settings > Variables.

list.name: instance
list.label: Instance
list.description: Gateway instances (scrape targets) on the selected hosts.

panels.title: Sources down
panels.description: Sources currently being reopened.

panels.title: Messages (range)
panels.description: Decoded messages in the selected time range.

panels.title: Sinks unhealthy
panels.description: Targets whose last attempt failed.

panels.title: Messages queued
panels.description: Messages waiting for delivery, all targets.

panels.title: Dead-lettered
panels.description: Messages that exhausted their delivery attempts.

panels.title: IQ blocks dropped
panels.description: IQ blocks dropped in the time range.

panels.title: Power and noise floor
panels.description: Channel power (RSSI) against the learnt idle noise floor, dBFS.

panels.title: Messages per channel
panels.description: Decoded messages per minute, stacked.

panels.title: Squelch gate
panels.description: 1 while the channel is considered active.

panels.title: Uncorrectable / invalid ratio
panels.description: Share of uncorrectable and invalid-frame events relative to decoded messages.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, channel) (rate(pagewire_decoder_events_total{instance=~"$instance", channel=~"$channel", event=~"uncorrectable|invalid_frame"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance, channel) (rate(pagewire_decoder_messages_total{instance=~"$instance", channel=~"$channel"}[$__rate_interval])), 1/60)

panels.title: Source state
panels.description: 1 while the source streams, 0 while it is being reopened.

panels.title: Pipeline load
panels.description: Processing time per block over its real-time duration. 1.0 = no headroom left.

panels.title: IQ clipping
panels.description: Share of ADC samples at full scale. Persistent clipping means too much gain.

panels.title: Target health
panels.description: 1 while the last delivery or check of the target succeeded.

panels.title: Deliveries by outcome
panels.description: Delivery attempts per minute by outcome.

panels.title: Delivery latency
panels.description: Duration of delivery attempts, p50 / p95 / p99.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Messages waiting for delivery.

panels.title: Gateways and sources
panels.description: Build and static source description (pagewire_build_info, pagewire_source_info).

panels.title: Source restarts
panels.description: Reopens after a failure (USB disconnect, stall).

panels.title: IQ blocks per second
panels.description: Blocks received from the source; a flat line means the stream stalled.

panels.title: Dropped IQ blocks
panels.description: Blocks dropped because processing fell behind. Should stay at zero.

panels.title: SNR
panels.description: Channel power above the noise floor.

panels.title: Carrier offset
panels.description: Estimated carrier offset of the last active block. Drift indicates a PPM error; see calibrate.

panels.title: Messages per protocol and kind
panels.description: Decoded messages per minute by protocol and message kind.

panels.title: Decoder events
panels.description: Sync and error-correction events per minute.

panels.title: Sync acquired vs. lost
panels.description: Frequent sync loss with few messages points to a weak or noisy signal.

panels.title: Bits corrected
panels.description: Error-correction work per minute; a rising trend precedes uncorrectable frames.

panels.title: Dead letters
panels.description: Messages that exhausted their attempts; they need manual attention (queue CLI).

panels.title: Queue overflow drops
panels.description: Messages discarded because the queue bound was exceeded (data loss).

panels.title: Failure ratio
panels.description: Share of attempts ending in rejected, error or dead.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, target) (rate(pagewire_sink_deliveries_total{instance=~"$instance", target=~"$target", outcome=~"rejected|error|dead"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance, target) (rate(pagewire_sink_deliveries_total{instance=~"$instance", target=~"$target"}[$__rate_interval])), 1/60)

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Delivery attempt durations per bucket.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds per second (1.0 = one full core).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size and Go heap in use.

panels.title: Goroutines and threads
panels.description: Goroutine and OS thread counts; steady growth indicates a leak.

panels.title: GC and open files
panels.description: GC pause time per second and open file descriptors.
